notes.title: Patch v1.26
notes.notes:
Hello!

Little patch for the weekend! I have to admit that I've been working on Lakeview Cabin 2 a lot this week and Valley has taken a step back. That, and I also finally build a pc and I've been slaying some demons... Been good for the mental health during these damned times. I hope everyone's doing well despite all of the stuff that's happening. Because hearing it from a random lone game developer is totally what you need...

Anyway, I still got some bugs squashed, here's the biggest ones:

 Increased “Pogo's” reach
 Tried a little fix for the black screen in cutscenes, they might load a bit longer now but at least they LOAD…
 Made sure the Preacher knows if you’re lying about being violent
 Tried a little fix for that one specific butterfly ruining your hobbies with other butterflies
 Sheriff shouldn’t stay clapping anymore
 Changed some lines in the Russian translation

notes.title: Patch v1.24
notes.notes:
v1.24
A little patch for the weekend! Small list but big fixes!

 Fixed problem with some flowers not growing properly
 Fixed the wings appearing ripped after bringing a new butterfly to the table
 Hopefully the state of the flowers will now save properly
 Added a new cheat “allmyseeds” which gives you 99 units of each seed
 Fixed the transition from Stuarts house north that caused some players to glitch out of the map

notes.title: Patch v1.23
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. I was down with the flu (still am) and wasn't able to get a patch up sooner. But here it is now, more fixes coming later this week!

List of changes:

 Fixed the muscle sore problem. It was actually giving you more stamina… (This is why, when someone asks me what I do for living, I still kinda cringe when I have to say I’m a game developer…)
 Fixed another muscle sore problem regarding the big flies
 Tried a little fix for the butterfly stuff not saving properly
 Fixed Donna’s butterfly
 Made sure the whole wing collection is visible…
 You can now find the jar and mug in the town, so you won’t lose them if you “travel” without them. They still might not be around on older saves.
 Fixed the butterflies staying during daylight
 Fixed some more stuff in that secret place that nobody seems to be talking about
 Tried a little fix for the underwater distortion staying on screen if you wait until midnight underwater
 Made sure the good doctor has his dialogue during _the_ rampage
 Fixed some portrait issues

notes.title: Patch v1.2ish(?)
notes.notes:
Ooookkay here's some more fixes. Feeling a bit hungover but I had to get these done today. I'll be back with more fixes tomorrow!

v1.2

 Made muscle soreness go away by sleeping
 Fixed the villagers spawning from the bottom of the map… Embarrassing bug, sorry!
 Fixed the mailbox not giving necessary items
 Made the “pogo” killable
 Reduced the amount of days some flowers need to grow

notes.title: Patch notes for last nights update
notes.notes:
This is not all the stuff that has changed but here's the big ones:

 Added flowers that you can grow
 Added alcohol into the game
 Made time skipping faster
 Made the doll into an item you do NOT want to find. Now it randomly changes places, but with a bit of investigation you can determine where it is.
 Fixed the “ineedmytools” cheat screwing up the cheat input
 Fixed the stalls and the npcs not working properly on the second Sunday
 Fixed Frank only warning you about collecting the sauna rocks, now he will attack after the first warning
 Fixed the “gym” not giving stamina
 Buffed the zombies a bit, but I think I need to completely rework how they behave in the future…
 Fixed your seed and flower collection not depleting correctly when used
 Changed all the status effects you get from drinking or smoking flowers
 Tried a little fix for the issue that caused the Sheriff or the Doctor to not appear at the hospital, causing the game to soft lock

notes.title: Lakeview Valley - new update
notes.notes:
Hey all. I just updated the game. Lots of new stuff. More bug fixes coming soon. Sorry I don't have time to explain. I'm just slightly impaired, and I'll probably regret this "news" in the morning. I'll be back after the weekend with a better explanation on what has been changed. Maybe we can just pretend this is some elaborate PR thing to appear more mysterious. 

Sorry!
I love you all!
Roope

notes.title: Patch v1.07
notes.notes:
v1.07

Sorry for not patching the game earlier this week, some of you may already know that I was bed-ridden with flu and fever this week. 
That’s no excuse though, and I reeeally want to update the game at least weekly. So here we are again, with a list of changes!

 Added a little text and audio cue to when it turns midnight
 Fixed the number keys sometimes not working for the inventory
 Made keyboard players able to change inventory slots with T and Y
 Made the map upgrade work with the Y button on a controller
 There was a problem with the randomised “treasure” dig-sites, fixed it, and also added almost the double amount of dig-sites to the game
 The metal-detector shouldn’t keep peeping after you’ve digged the hole anymore
 The cat and the dog should not get suspicion “pop-ups” over their heads anymore
 Made Dr Don move a bit slower
 Made sure the Sheriff’s contribution to the building of the stage gets reset if you “travel”
 Made sure the Sheriff’s decision to start with the song gets reset if you “travel”
 Fixed the “bone throwing” problem if you “travel”
 Made sure the Hermit doesn’t give his “gift” speech if you’ve already gone to bed
 The signed work permit will now be removed if you “travel”
 Found a reason why the “big guy” didn’t take damage from the chainsaw, fixed it
 Made sure Luanne’s shop doesn’t leave the “sell prompt” open if you exit during it
 Tweaked a thing with the Scarecrow, so that “thing” should now work if you “travel”
 Made a promise to myself not use as many quotation marks in future patch-notes

notes.title: Patch v1.06
notes.notes:
v1.06
This one is a bit of a smaller patch since I’ve been working on the Upper League update, and had to disable most of the stuff I’m adding to the game soon ;) Also had a bit of a problem with my software subscriptions, which is another reason why this patch took a few days longer to get out.

List of changes:

 Added 15 new outfits
 Added 6 new hairstyles
 Added a delay to crapping your pants so you have time to react
 Fixed the bald hair not working
 Added a little tweak that should allow you to get out of a shop, even after closing time
 Made the number of flies reset when “traveling”
 Made the time warping move the clock faster
 Fixed the home award achievement not unlocking
 Hopefully fixed the issue that caused you to transport to black screen area when you drag an object and die

notes.title: Patch v1.05
notes.notes:
v1.05

 Drew portraits for all the villager faces you can wear
 Fixed the “Fall of morality” achievement
 Made it so you lose the Sheriffs trust if you “travel”
 Fixed the instance that caused Morgo to stop doing what he’s doing on Sunday (you know what I’m talking about)
 Tweaked a thing that might’ve caused the murdered NPCs to disappear after you killed them and “traveled”
 Made it so you can still heal yourself at the doctor, even if there’s someone to meet him
 Fixed the problem with the pause menu in the underworld
 Made it so Morgo should now only focus on the villagers on Sunday

notes.title: Patch v1.04
notes.notes:
v1.04


 Fixed the remaining achievements not working. Really sorry about this one, I know how annoying it must have been to not unlock the achievements!
 Fixed the softlock that happened if you continue on Saturday after dying instead of restarting the day
 Added an offset to where the masks drop when you use beds or chairs etc. so you will be able pick them up again more easily
 The arrow keys should work for movement now
 Fixed the worm partly staying on your yard if you swim away
 Made George have his regular shop dialogue if you talk to him while Ruth is there
 Made the stubs in your yard disappear after you get the better lawn
 Made sure the credits don’t loop after waiting too long
 The clock will now hopefully disappear if you die while “time skipping”
 Made Ivan sleep on a futon so I was able to remove the collider so you’ll have an easier time fucking him, YOU’RE WELCOME!
 Fixed the scarecrow thing (that not many have found)
 Fixed the colliders near the eastern bridge that allowed you to glitch out of the map
 Tweaked the fishing mini-game since the rod disappears if you exit while the fish is showing

notes.title: Patch v1.03
notes.notes:
v1.03


 The achievements should work now! 
 Found a reason why Jimmy suddenly disappeared at the arcade cabinet. Added a little fix so it shouldn’t happen with any NPCs anymore. Unless it’s midnight of course.
 The stage floors quest should now reset if you travel
 Tweaked the pathfinding, it might still cause some slowdown but I’ll keep optimising it
 Fixed Amy’s body not registering to anyones eyes when you drag her
 Fixed the NPCs doing that weird shuffle and then teleporting back to their location. They still do the shuffle but at least they don’t teleport now…
 Added some precautions to the “restart day” mechanic so everything gets destroyed and reloaded properly, hopefully it helps with the duplication problem
 Made BumBum to re-path himself if he deems himself stuck
 Fixed the embarrassing “Return to title sreen” typo…

notes.title: Patch v1.02
notes.notes:
v1.02
First patch after release! I wasn't able to get everything I wanted done today but tomorrow is a new day! If you're enjoying the game, consider leaving a review, it really helps the game to show up to more people!

Here's a list of all the changes:

 Fixed the looping problem if you go into the water on the last Sunday
 Found a possible reason that might’ve caused the Sheriff to always say you were reported of suspicious activity, even if you weren’t, fixed it
 Made the footstep sounds stop when you’re in a cutscene
 Dropping an item while swimming will now make you lose the item! So be careful not to drop anything valuable!
 Made sure the severed heads get removed if you travel
 You should now be able to exit the map with the “B button” on a controller
 Added a little more feedback for when you kill that mysterious creature
 Made sure the footsteps get muted when you pause the game
 Fixed (hopefully) the mysterious creature’s animation problems
 Fixed Matt thinking that Donna is dead right after starting a new game
 Added the big guy to the list that gets reset if you travel
 Fixed the collider problem near the abandoned house
 Made sure the number of snakes you have killed will reset if you travel
 Fixed Ruth doing that weird teleport thing at the beginning of the game
 Fixed the thing on that bridge in that one place not counting the killed villagers properly
 Fixed the prices at Amy’s stall AGAIN SINCE I’M AN IDIOT!
 Fixed Morgo telling the story again and again and again
 Made sure Luanne actually leaves when she is done at your home
 The shotgun works, but the spread made it miss easily, so I doubled the amount of pellets it releases on a shot
 Made it so that one gentleman acts independently on LakeDay if you haven’t taken any help from him
 Made it so the shroom affects a certain dialogue between two characters
 Tried a little fix for the Mystery Ladys certain dialogue not activating properly. Not sure if it helped since I couldn’t find an obvious reason for what might cause it
 Added some dialogue if you bring the Sheriff to a certain place
 Made it so the game also saves your current selected inventory slot, not sure if it helps with the item duplication problem but fingers crossed!
 Fixed the weird clipping problem with Mary
 I reduced the time warp speed that happens when you sit on a bench. The minutes should still go about as fast as before but the characters will move a bit slower. The faster it goes, the easier they get stuck inside walls so let’s try this

notes.title: Patch v0.34
notes.notes:
The beta is now over, and the game is almost content ready. If you still have the game in your library, congratulations, you earned yourself a free game!

Here are the changes:

 You may notice there are more trash containers in the game now…
 I’m trying a thing with the resolution, let me know if it causes frustration (some of the pause menu buttons look a bit off right now because of this, will fix)
 Prettied up the Lakemart and the Sheriff’s office
 Tried a little fix for that big guy getting stuck
 Nerfed the sword a bit, still too OP I think
 Fixed the stage collider being there even if there are no poles on the ground
 Tried a little fix for BumBums music staying on after you are done with him
 Removed the ring item and added two other items you will be able to find
 The metal detector didn’t work if you switched to it from another item in the inventory, fixed it
 The metal detector didn’t alert you about “treasures” that have predetermined locations (example graves), it should now alert you about them too
 Tried a little fix for the big guys music staying on after you die
 Found a reason the NPCs might stop following you and just staying idle when you are fighting them, fixed it. Hopefully it was the only reason it happened.
 Fixed the shop buy prompts looking flat
 Tried a fix for the weird lines appearing between the tiles at some areas
 Changed some dialogue that refererred to the burned house
 Added some dialogue for Lil Bobby
 Fixed the bug that caused the continue button to not work even if the doctor is alive
